constraints: Keep .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI matrices, and container images on one supported Scala 3 LTS or Next line.
Confirm dependencies publish for the target Scala 3 line and re-resolve with sbt after changing the runtime.

steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from Scala 3.0–3.2 to a supported release (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the Scala version

steps.instructions: Update .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI matrices, and Dockerfile Scala images so they agree.
steps.title: Align other Scala version surfaces

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Scala runtime is the intended release.
Compile the project on the new Scala.
Run the sbt test suite on the new Scala.

rule.replacement: Scala 3.3 LTS or a current Scala Next / LTS line
rule.summary: The Scala project's development guarantees page states that a non-LTS Scala 3 minor receives patches only until the next minor ships. Scala 3.0, 3.1, and 3.2 are frozen on their last patches; later fixes landed only in 3.3 LTS and newer lines.
rule.title: Scala 3.0–3.2 no longer receive patches
